title: Housing Deposit Rush
scenario: A landlord says many students want the room and asks for a deposit before a viewing.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.C: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Housing Deposit Rush: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Never pay before verifying the listing, landlord, and property.
